```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(mgcv)
library(emmeans)
```

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
df <- read.csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stat870/fall2026/refs/heads/main/data/hens.csv") |> 
  mutate(hen =as.factor(hen))
head(df)

df |> 
  ggplot(aes(age, bw))+
  geom_point(aes(color = factor(hen)))+
  labs(color= "Hen ID", y ="Body weight (lb)")+
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(1,3.5))+
  theme_classic()
```

$$y_{ij} \sim N(\mu_{ij}, \sigma^2), \\ \mu_{ij} = 
\beta_0 + hen_j + f(x_{ij}).$$



```{r}
m <- gam(bw ~ 1 + hen + s(age, bs = "tp", k = 13), data = df)
gam.check(m)
```


```{r}
df_pred <- expand.grid(age = min(df$age):max(df$age), 
                       hen= unique(df$hen))
df_pred$yhat <- predict(m, newdata = df_pred)
```



```{r}

df |> 
  ggplot(aes(age, bw))+
  geom_line(aes(color = factor(hen), y = yhat), data = df_pred)+
  geom_point(aes(color = factor(hen)))+
  labs(color= "Hen ID")+
  theme_classic()

```

```{r}
plot(emtrends(m, ~age, "age", at =list(hen= factor(1), 
                                  age =175:190)))
```



```{r}
m2 <- gam(adg ~ 1 + hen + s(age, bs = "tp", k = 13), data = df)
gam.check(m2)

plot(emmeans(m2, ~ age, at =list(hen= factor(1), 
                                  age =175:190)))
```











When = $f'(x) = 0$



```{r}
df_pred <- expand.grid(age = seq(175, 185, by = .1), 
                       hen= factor(1))
df_pred$yhat <- predict(m, newdata = df_pred)

df_pred <- df_pred |> 
  mutate(y_diff = (yhat - lag(yhat))/.1)

df_pred |> 
  ggplot(aes(age, y_diff))+
  geom_line()
```


```{r}
df_pred |> filter(y_diff == min(abs(df_pred$y_diff), na.rm = T))
```
